description: Create or replace a local stdio MCP server configuration at the user's request. The saved server is disabled; this tool never starts it.

propertyDescriptions.command: Executable program, stored as an argv program rather than a shell command.
propertyDescriptions.args: Exact argument vector; do not concatenate a shell command.
propertyDescriptions.cwd: Working directory for the server; defaults to the current workspace.
propertyDescriptions.env: Environment variable references, never raw secret values.
propertyDescriptions.env[].name: Environment variable name made available to the server.
propertyDescriptions.env[].source: Reference in env:NAME form, not a secret value.

guidance: Only save MCP configuration when the user explicitly asks. Do not put raw secrets in arguments or configuration. The user must separately enable and approve execution in /mcp.
